g.text: The workflow begins with the Iterative Latent Diffusion Separation stage.
Two input images are provided, labeled No-Flash and Flash.
Both images are routed into encoders labeled E.
The encoders produce feature volumes labeled No-flash and Flash.
These feature volumes are merged through concatenation operations along with a central Noise volume.
This creates two combined latent volumes feeding into parallel pathways.
The volumes enter two UNet networks connected symmetrically through a Cross Attention module.
The upper stream outputs a latent volume labeled Refl, and the lower stream outputs one labeled Trans.
Next, the pipeline moves to the Cross Latent Decoding stage.
The Flash input image is supplied to the decoding architecture.
The decoder processes the Flash image with a Zero Conv block while integrating the Trans latent representation.
Finally, the network generates the decoded output image labeled Trans.
